briefing: Market data was unavailable today and NASDAQ/S&P were flat, so there's no clear directional signal. We held all 7 existing positions and added one modest medium-conviction position (HUBS) to use an open slot, picking the candidate with the safest RSI margin rather than chasing the most overbought names.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: RSI (Relative Strength Index) and MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) are tools traders use to spot stocks with building upward momentum. A stock with RSI in the 50-70 range plus a bullish MACD crossover suggests buyers are in control without the stock being dangerously overbought yet.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: RSI（相對強弱指數）同MACD（指數平滑異同移動平均線）係交易者用嚟捕捉股票上升動力嘅工具。當RSI處於50至70之間，加上MACD出現黃金交叉，代表買方力量主導，而股票尚未進入超買嘅危險區域。

market_education.summary_en: No market data feed was available today, so index moves for NASDAQ and the S&P 500 could not be confirmed and are shown as flat by default. Without fresh headlines or price action to analyze, we avoided making broad directional bets. Instead we relied on the underlying stock screener's technical signals (RSI, MACD, moving averages) to size a single cautious new position.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日市場數據來源暫時無法取得，納指及標普500的實際升跌未能確認，系統預設顯示持平。由於缺乏最新新聞及價格走勢可供分析，我們避免作出大方向的押注，改為依賴選股工具的技術指標（RSI、MACD、移動平均線）審慎建立一個新持倉。
